personality_one_liner: A highly readable, authoritative clinical tool designed for rapid data retrieval in harsh surgical lighting environments.

spacing.rule: Generous paddings around patient details for error-free tapping in surgical settings. Avoid dense layouts.

do's: Use subtle glass effect on the sticky search/filter bar to keep context while scrolling patient lists.
Use on the floating action button (FAB) over a brandTertiary base.
dont's: Do not use on patient data cards or clinical records where strict readability is paramount.
Avoid heavy blur on forms or settings.

screens.name: Auth (PIN/Biometrics)
screens.purpose: Secure gateway for surgeons entering the app.

states.error: Shake animation and red text on incorrect PIN.

screens.layout: Centered numpad using Space Grotesk tabular figures. Biometric (Face ID / Fingerprint) icon centered below the PIN dots. Highly legible and minimal.

screens.name: Dashboard
screens.purpose: Patient list with powerful search, dynamic sorting, and quick-glance X-ray thumbnails.

states.empty: Illustration of medical clipboard + 'No patients found' + 'Add Patient' CTA.

screens.layout: Sticky header with Search bar and a horizontally scrollable chip row for Sorting (Name, Date, Pre-op, Post-op). Main content is a vertical list of Patient Cards. Cards have Demographics on the left (Name, Age, DOS) and a thumbnail stack of X-rays on the right. FAB (+ Add Patient) floating at bottom right with glass effect.

screens.name: Add/Edit Patient Form
screens.purpose: Data entry for Demographics, Clinical History, DOS, and Outcomes.

states.loading: Saving state spinner inside the submit button.
states.error: Inline validation messages for required fields.

screens.layout: Single-column scrollable form. Grouped sections (Demographics, History, Outcomes) with subtle dividers. 'Save Patient' CTA is sticky at the bottom inside KeyboardAvoidingView.

screens.name: Patient Detail (Tabbed)
screens.purpose: Comprehensive view of a single patient's journey, documents, and clinical outcomes.

states.loading: Skeleton view of patient header and tab content.
states.empty: No media/history found for this tab.

screens.layout: Top section: Sticky Patient Header (Name, Age, Sex, Mobile, DOS). Below: Segmented control for tabs (Demographics, History, Comparison, Results, Video). 'Comparison' tab splits the view horizontally (Pre-op top, Post-op bottom) or uses a slider overlay for precise alignment. Media tabs use a grid layout for thumbnails.

screens.name: Media Comparison Viewer
screens.purpose: Side-by-side or sliding comparison of Pre-op vs Post-op X-rays.

states.empty: Prompt to upload matching Pre and Post-op files.

screens.layout: Full screen modal. Top/Bottom split layout with pinch-to-zoom enabled on both simultaneously (if possible) or an interactive before/after slider overlaying the images. Dark slate background to simulate light-box contrast.

dashboard_empty_state.alt: Clinical slate abstract background for empty state

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement clinical slate/teal palette strictly. Ensure WCAG AA contrast for text, specifically in surgical environments (dark mode).
Use Space Grotesk for clinical tabular figures (dates, ages, phone numbers) and Geist for long-form clinical notes.
The Dashboard requires a pinned search and horizontally scrolling sort chips. Make sure the Patient Card accommodates a thumbnail strip for X-rays.
Ensure 'Add Patient' FAB uses an expo-blur backdrop and is correctly anchored above safe areas.
Implement the Patient Detail view with a sticky header and a smooth Segmented Control for the tabs (Demographics, History, Comparison, Results, Video).

For the Media Comparison view, build a dedicated component that splits the screen or uses an interactive slider to compare Pre-op and Post-op images. The background must be dark (simulating an X-ray light box).
Implement robust pinch-to-zoom for the image viewer using react-native-gesture-handler.
No emojis anywhere. Use professional Ionicons for all actions.
